title: Advanced Professional Certificate Course in Performance Marketing in Search and Social
description: The course aims to master the intricacies of data-driven strategies to optimize search and social media channels for effective business growth.
longDescription: The Advanced Professional Certificate in Performance Marketing in Search and Social is designed to sharpen your digital marketing prowess. Delve into the foundations of performance marketing, gaining insights into its evolution and understanding key metrics and KPIs. Navigate the realm of Search Engine Marketing (SEM), exploring everything from search engine intricacies to effective ad campaign creation using Google Ads. Unleash the potential of Social Media Advertising as you learn to strategically select platforms, segment target audiences, and craft compelling campaigns across various channels. Elevate your skills further by mastering the art of integrating SEM and social media into a seamless marketing strategy. With a focus on tracking and analytics tools, real-world case studies, and staying abreast of industry trends, this course propels you towards expertise in driving impactful digital marketing results.
courseDetails: Comprehend the fundamentals of Search Engine Marketing (SEM). Gain insight into the functionalities of major search engines like Google and Bing. Master keyword research and selection techniques for targeted campaigns. Develop proficiency in crafting impactful ad campaigns utilizing Google Ads. Hone skills in ad copywriting and conducting A/B testing for optimization. Implement strategies to improve Quality Score and Ad Rank. Learn effective budgeting and bidding strategies for SEM campaigns. Utilize tools and techniques to track and measure the performance of SEM initiatives. Introduction to social media advertising. Choosing the right social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn, etc.) Target audience segmentation and persona development. Integration of SEM and social media into a cohesive marketing strategy. Tracking and analytics tools (Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel). Performance marketing case studies and best practices. Staying updated with industry trends. The Advanced Professional Certificate in Performance Marketing in Search and Social is designed to explore the intricacies of search engine marketing (SEM) - from keyword research to budgeting strategies. Dive into the realm of social media advertising, mastering platform selection, audience segmentation, and persona development. Elevate your expertise with insights into performance marketing strategies, optimization techniques, and hands-on experience with tracking tools like Google Analytics and Facebook Pixel. Through real-world case studies and a focus on industry trends, emerge equipped to seamlessly integrate SEM and social media into a unified, results-driven marketing strategy. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Introduction to Performance Marketing Search Engine Marketing Essentials Social Media Advertising Performance Marketing Strategies and Optimisation

modules.title: Performance Marketing-Search And Social
modules.summary: Advanced Professional Certificate Course in Performance Marketing-Search and Social delve into the foundations of performance marketing, exploring its evolution, significance, and essential metrics. In the Search Engine Marketing (SEM) module, unravel the intricacies of SEM, from search engine dynamics to keyword research, ad campaign creation using Google Ads, and optimizing Quality Score and Ad Rank. Seamlessly transition into the Social Media Advertising section, where you'll navigate the landscape of platforms like Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn, honing skills in audience segmentation and persona development. The course culminates in Performance Marketing Strategies and Optimization, integrating SEM and social media into a unified marketing strategy. Elevate your expertise through hands-on experiences with tracking tools, analytics, and real-world case studies, ensuring you stay abreast of industry trends and emerge as a proficient performance marketing strategist.
